  • The power to shapeshift, to alter your body in any way you see fit, a power forced upon you, an 18-year-old boy, by monsters of unknown origin. How will you use this power? To seduce? To kill? Don’t get too comfortable though, the monsters that you thought were a once-in-a-lifetime occurrence are showing up all over the world, even on the news.
